changelog.title: Waves 0 to 2 complete
changelog.body: The foundation is in: contracts and a data layer with tenant row-level security, a connections registry with an encrypted vault, and a truth library where the writer never types a number and claims fill slots. The approval gate is in: a person signs the exact content hash, checks are bound to that content, and they are re-checked before publishing. Production is in: a brand system with a template renderer and design lint, text providers and copy production, a publisher with exactly-once sends, and a first web app with sign-in, review deck, week plan and connections. Over 2,480 automated tests run against a real Postgres on every change, and every package passed an independent review and a security review before merge. Next: the check stack with a visual quality layer, a design pass on the app, then the first pilot.

changelog.title: WP-00: contracts frozen before the agents fan out
changelog.body: Before several agents build in parallel, everything they share gets pinned down first: typed tables generated from the models, state machines, event types, and one connection contract with a mock for each outside capability. After the freeze, additive changes are allowed and breaking ones are not, so packages can be built side by side without stepping on each other.

changelog.title: Plan of record: 42 work packages in 8 waves
changelog.body: The full build is split into 42 self-contained work packages across 8 waves. Each package has an owner, a file scope, its dependencies and a test that says it is done. Every wave ends in a working system, so the build can pause after any wave and still be usable.
